articles.summary: Accessories inventory optimization sets depth for bags, scarves, and small leather goods by role, attach rate, and gifting peaks. 46% of US shoppers want them.

articles.summary: The reorder point formula is (average daily demand x lead time) + safety stock. See worked examples with variable demand and lead time, from 549 to 690 units.
articles.title: Reorder point formula: worked examples for variable demand

articles.summary: To reduce stockouts in retail, fix the cause first: about 47% of out-of-stocks start with store ordering and forecasting. Here is how to find and fix yours.
articles.title: How to reduce stockouts in retail, cause by cause

articles.title: Apparel inventory planning: a guide to sizes and buys

articles.summary: Beauty inventory management sets stock by product role, shade, and expiry window. US prestige beauty grew 4% to $36B in 2025: here is how to plan the stock.
articles.title: Beauty inventory management: shades, expiry, and launches

articles.summary: Machine learning demand forecasting wins when products share drivers like price and promotions, yet only 7.5% of M5 teams beat a simple statistical benchmark.
articles.title: Machine learning demand forecasting: methods, data, limits

articles.summary: Inventory carrying costs made up 30.4% of US logistics costs in 2025. Learn the inventory carrying cost formula, its four parts, and how to bring the rate down.
articles.title: Inventory carrying cost: formula, components, how to cut it

articles.summary: Days of inventory on hand = average inventory at cost / COGS x days. Large North American firms average 56 days. See the formula and how to reduce yours.
articles.title: Days of inventory on hand: formula and how to reduce it

articles.title: Sell-through rate: formula, benchmarks, and how to use it

articles.summary: GMROI is gross margin divided by average inventory at cost. See the formula, a worked example by category, and why a 30% margin category can return 3.43.
articles.title: GMROI: formula, worked example, and how buyers use it

articles.summary: US clothing stores held about 61 days of sales in stock in August 2026, grocers about 25. Here is what a good DIO for retail looks like and how to judge yours.
articles.title: What is a good DIO for retail? Benchmarks by sub-sector

articles.summary: Furniture demand planning starts from written orders, not deliveries. US furniture makers carried a $2.64bn order backlog in June 2026. Here is the method.
articles.title: Furniture demand planning: a practical guide for retailers
